$comment: Copy this file to the ROOT of the project you want Claude Code to search,
rename it to '.mcp.json', and edit the two values below.
command  -> absolute path to coderag-mcp ('which coderag-mcp').
An absolute path matters: Claude Code spawns the process
CODERAG_DATABASE_URL -> the URL 'coderag localdb start' printed
expansion, so paste the literal value.
Then reload VS Code / restart Claude Code and run /mcp to confirm.
